name: Nanaze Mizumi
source:
Izumi's younger sister who is actually still in grade school and lives away from her. Many people often mistake her to be a high school student due to her breast size. Mizumi is blunt and always throwing her opinions (no matter how brutally honest) out, but what she hides is that she's actually quite knowledgeable about sex for a grade schooler.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=729464&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
